statements.subject: server
statements.description: Accordingly, a POP3 server which implements both the PASS and APOP commands should not allow both methods of access for a given user; that is, for a given mailbox name, either the USER/PASS command sequence or the APOP command is allowed, but not both.
actions: determine configured authentication method for the given mailbox name
reject authentication attempt that uses the non-permitted method for that mailbox
